title: Cover
description: Title slide for the Deer Lake Community General Store operational plan.

title: The problem and the opportunity
description: Why a community-owned store now: incumbent reality, leakage estimate, subsidy pass-through, and the community-owned alternative.

title: Why current stores fail — market structure & ownership
description: Theme 1 of the failure-mode synthesis: who owns the store, who decides what's on the shelf, and where the federal subsidy actually goes. Reads from the shared @workspace/why-stores-fail catalog with a per-slide Sources footer generated from sourcesFooterLine().

title: Why current stores fail — supply chain & operations
description: Themes 2 + 3 of the failure-mode synthesis: how freight, hours-of-service rules, and a southern operating playbook break a northern store. Per-slide Sources footer generated from the shared catalog.

title: Why current stores fail — producer & financing side
description: Theme 4 of the failure-mode synthesis (producer wholesale lockout, capital access gap, processing infrastructure gap) plus the working community-owned counter-examples (Arctic Co-ops, Mistissini Meechum) and a per-slide Sources footer.

title: Supply chain and distribution
description: Three-lane supply model (807 producer lane, ice-road truck, air freight) and the curated shelf mix.

title: The Outback staffing model
description: Rotational fly-in staffing with band-provided housing, paired with a 12-month local-hire wind-down.

title: Day-1 POS and operations
description: Square for Retail configuration, offline mode, subsidy pass-through automation, and the companion canvas mockup.

title: Financials, timeline, and role
description: Planning-grade financial sketch, 6 to 9 month launch gantt, and the recommended 807 Store Launch Lead role with alternative.

title: Operations & technology partner
description: What the band pays the operations & technology partner ($94k/mo = $69.7k cost basis + $24.3k 35% reinvestment) and what stays in the community when the contract ends — 9 servers, privacy phones, public price dashboard, household lookup, six-module playbook, and an annual value-delivered audit.

title: Risks and the ask
description: Top six operational risks with mitigations, and the closing ask mirroring the existing 807 partnership pitch tone.
